references.label: Top rollover lanes
references.description: The rollover lanes across the top light matching bumpers, kickout holes, and side rollovers.

references.context: Plunge Light A or Light B first.
references.label: Light A top lane
references.description: The A lane is the left labeled lighting lane below the upper rollovers.

references.context: Plunge Light A or Light B first.
references.label: Light B top lane
references.description: The B lane is the right labeled lighting lane below the upper rollovers.

references.label: Center kickout holes
references.description: The two center holes kick the ball back toward the top of the playfield.

references.label: Side kickout holes
references.description: The outer holes kick toward the lower flippers; learn each return before repeating it.

references.label: Lit bottom rollovers
references.description: The two lower outside rollovers score 200 when lit and lead toward the outlanes.
